dishes.name: Kare raisu
dishes.veganApproach: Skip the meat and use a dairy-free roux (many store-bought blocks contain milk or meat extracts) or a homemade flour-and-curry-powder roux, adding mushrooms or tofu for body.
dishes.technique: Onions, carrots and potatoes are sautéed and simmered in stock, then curry roux blocks are melted in off the heat until the sauce turns thick and glossy.

sources.title: Vegetarian Japanese Curry - Just One Cookbook

dishes.name: Katsu kare
dishes.veganApproach: Pressed firm tofu is coated in a flour-and-water slurry and panko instead of egg, fried, and served with a dairy-free curry sauce.
dishes.technique: A breaded cutlet is deep-fried until golden, sliced and laid over rice beside a thick Japanese curry sauce.

sources.title: Vegan Tofu Katsu Curry - Okonomi Kitchen

dishes.name: Shoyu ramen
dishes.veganApproach: A kombu and dried shiitake broth seasoned with soy tare replaces the chicken stock, topped with mushrooms or tofu; vegetarians can keep the marinated soft-boiled egg.
dishes.technique: A clear stock is poured over a concentrated soy sauce tare in the bowl, then springy noodles and toppings are added at the last moment.

sources.title: Easy Vegan Shoyu Ramen - Okonomi Kitchen
Vegan Shoyu Ramen - The Foodie Takes Flight

dishes.name: Miso ramen
dishes.veganApproach: Use kombu-shiitake or vegetable stock and soy mince or tofu crumbles in place of pork, finishing with vegan butter; vegetarians can add real butter and an egg.
dishes.technique: Garlic, ginger and minced protein are stir-fried with vegetables, then deglazed with stock and miso for a rich, cloudy broth.

sources.title: Miso Ramen Recipe - Keeping the Peas

dishes.name: Tonkotsu ramen
dishes.veganApproach: The milky pork-bone broth is imitated with soy milk, sesame paste and kombu-shiitake dashi, topped with marinated tofu or mushrooms.
dishes.technique: Pork bones are boiled hard for hours to emulsify fat and collagen into an opaque, creamy broth served over thin, firm noodles.

dishes.name: Kake udon
dishes.veganApproach: Swap the bonito dashi for kombu and dried shiitake dashi; the rest of the bowl is already plant-based.
dishes.technique: Thick wheat noodles are reheated and served in a hot, light dashi broth seasoned with soy sauce and mirin.

sources.title: Udon Noodle Soup - Just One Cookbook
Vegan Shiitake Kombu Dashi - Just One Cookbook

dishes.name: Yaki udon
dishes.veganApproach: Leave out the pork and bonito flakes, add mushrooms or tofu, and season with soy sauce, mirin and a vegan mentsuyu.
dishes.technique: Thick udon are stir-fried over high heat with vegetables and seasoned with a soy-based sauce until lightly caramelized.

sources.title: Yaki Udon (Japanese Stir-Fried Udon Noodles) - Plant-Based Matters

dishes.name: Yakisoba
dishes.veganApproach: Skip the pork and use a Worcestershire-style sauce without anchovy, adding tofu or mushrooms for protein.
dishes.technique: Steamed wheat noodles are stir-fried with cabbage and pork, then coated in a sweet-savory Worcestershire-based sauce.

dishes.name: Zaru soba
dishes.nameEn: Chilled buckwheat noodles with dipping sauce
dishes.veganApproach: Make the dipping sauce with kombu-shiitake dashi instead of bonito; the noodles and garnishes are already plant-based.
dishes.technique: Soba is boiled briefly, rinsed in ice water to firm it up and served on a bamboo tray with a chilled dipping sauce.

sources.title: Zaru Soba (Cold Soba Noodles) - Just One Cookbook

dishes.name: Okonomiyaki
dishes.veganApproach: Replace the eggs with grated nagaimo or extra starch, use kombu dashi in the batter and top with vegan mayo instead of bonito flakes.
dishes.technique: A batter loaded with shredded cabbage is cooked as a thick pancake on a griddle, flipped once, then painted with sauce and mayonnaise.

dishes.name: Gyoza
dishes.veganApproach: Fill egg-free wrappers with finely chopped cabbage, mushrooms and crumbled firm tofu instead of pork.
dishes.technique: Pleated dumplings are pan-fried until browned on the bottom, then steamed under a lid with a splash of water and crisped again.

dishes.name: Tempura
dishes.nameEn: Japanese battered fried seafood and vegetables
dishes.veganApproach: Make the batter with flour, starch and ice-cold water (or sparkling water) without egg, fry only vegetables and serve with a kombu-based tentsuyu.
dishes.technique: Ingredients are dipped in a barely mixed, ice-cold batter and deep-fried briefly so the coating stays lacy, light and crisp.

dishes.name: Salmon teriyaki
dishes.veganApproach: Swap the salmon for starch-dusted slabs of firm tofu, pan-fried and glazed with the same soy, mirin and sake sauce.
dishes.technique: Fish is pan-seared, then glazed in a reduction of soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar until shiny.

dishes.name: Tonkatsu
dishes.veganApproach: Use pressed firm or frozen-and-thawed tofu, coated in a flour-and-water slurry and panko, served with a vegan tonkatsu sauce.
dishes.technique: A thick cutlet is breaded in flour, egg and coarse panko and deep-fried, then sliced and served with shredded cabbage.

sources.title: Vegan tofu katsu - The Japan Times

dishes.name: Karaage
dishes.veganApproach: Frozen-then-thawed firm tofu is torn into chunks, marinated in the same soy, ginger and garlic mix and double-fried in starch.
dishes.technique: Marinated pieces are dredged in potato starch and double-fried for a thin, shattering crust.

dishes.name: Onigiri
dishes.veganApproach: Choose plant fillings such as umeboshi, kombu tsukudani, seasoned mushrooms or miso and skip the fish.
dishes.technique: Freshly cooked rice is shaped by hand with salted palms around a filling, then wrapped in nori.

sources.title: Vegan Onigiri (Japanese Rice Ball) - Okonomi Kitchen

dishes.name: Nigiri-zushi
dishes.veganApproach: Top the seasoned rice with grilled eggplant, avocado, marinated shiitake or tomato 'tuna' instead of fish.
dishes.technique: Vinegared rice is pressed by hand into small oblongs, dabbed with wasabi and topped with a slice of fish.

sources.title: The Ultimate Guide to Sushi - Just One Cookbook
How to Make Nigiri - Serious Eats
Vegan Nigiri - The Cheap Lazy Vegan

dishes.name: Maki-zushi
dishes.veganApproach: Fill the rolls with cucumber, avocado, pickled daikon, kanpyo and simmered shiitake; vegetarians can add tamagoyaki.
dishes.technique: Seasoned rice is spread on nori, lined with fillings and rolled tight with a bamboo mat before slicing.

sources.title: Vegetarian Sushi Rolls - Just One Cookbook

dishes.name: Chahan
dishes.veganApproach: Leave out the pork and replace the egg with crumbled tofu, seasoning with soy sauce and a vegan chicken-style bouillon.
dishes.technique: Day-old rice is tossed in a very hot pan with beaten egg so each grain is coated and separate.

sources.title: Easy Fried Rice - Just One Cookbook
Vegan Japanese Fried Rice - Vegan Japanese

dishes.name: Tantanmen
dishes.veganApproach: Vegan mince or tofu crumbles replace the pork, and the creamy broth is built on soy milk, sesame paste and kombu dashi.
dishes.technique: A spicy sesame base is whisked with hot broth in the bowl, then noodles are added and topped with stir-fried seasoned mince.

sources.title: Tan Tan Ramen (Tantanmen) - Just One Cookbook
Vegan Tantanmen With Pan-Fried Tofu - NYT Cooking

dishes.name: Kitsune udon
dishes.veganApproach: Use kombu-shiitake dashi for both the soup and the sweet simmering liquid for the fried tofu.
dishes.technique: Fried tofu pouches are simmered in sweetened soy and dashi until they soak up the liquid, then laid over udon in hot broth.

dishes.name: Hiyashi chuka
dishes.veganApproach: Skip the ham, imitation crab and egg strips and top with tofu or vegan ham; vegetarians can keep the thin egg omelette.
dishes.technique: Noodles are boiled, chilled in ice water and topped with neatly julienned toppings, then dressed with a tangy soy-vinegar or sesame sauce.

sources.title: Hiyashi Chuka (Cold Ramen) - Just One Cookbook
Vegan Hiyashi Chuka (Cold Ramen) - Okonomi Kitchen

dishes.name: Hiyashi somen
dishes.veganApproach: Make the tsuyu with kombu dashi, which turns this simple summer dish fully plant-based.
dishes.technique: Very thin wheat noodles cook in a minute, are rinsed in cold water and served on ice with a concentrated dipping sauce.

sources.title: Japanese Cold Somen Noodles - Just One Cookbook

dishes.name: Katsudon
dishes.veganApproach: Use a panko-crusted tofu cutlet simmered in kombu-dashi broth with a silken tofu scramble in place of egg; vegetarians can keep the egg.
dishes.technique: A fried cutlet is simmered briefly with onions in sweet dashi, bound with lightly beaten egg and slid over rice.

sources.title: Japanese-Style Katsudon Rice Bowls (Vegan) - The Foodie Takes Flight

dishes.name: Gyudon
dishes.veganApproach: Thin strips of maitake mushroom or rehydrated soy curls stand in for the beef, simmered in a sweet soy and kombu-dashi broth.
dishes.technique: Thin slices are simmered quickly with onion in a sweet soy-dashi broth and spooned over rice with their juices.

dishes.name: Oyakodon
dishes.veganApproach: Fried tofu replaces the chicken and a soft silken-tofu scramble mimics the egg; vegetarians can pair tofu with real eggs.
dishes.technique: Chicken and onion are simmered in sweet dashi, then beaten eggs are poured over and cooked just until softly set.

sources.title: Vegan Tofu Oyakodon - Shinagawa Japanese Cooking
Vegetarian Tofu Oyakodon - Shinagawa Japanese Cooking

dishes.name: Tendon
dishes.veganApproach: Top the rice with eggless vegetable tempura and drizzle with a sweet sauce built on kombu-shiitake dashi.
dishes.technique: Freshly fried tempura is briefly dipped in a thick, sweet soy-mirin sauce and piled over hot rice.

sources.title: Ten Don (Tempura Rice Bowl) - Just One Cookbook

dishes.name: Unadon
dishes.veganApproach: Pan-fried or grilled eggplant (or tofu-and-nori 'eel') is glazed with the same sweet soy-mirin kabayaki sauce.
dishes.technique: Eel fillets are grilled and basted repeatedly with a thick sweet soy tare, then laid over rice.

dishes.name: Sukiyaki
dishes.veganApproach: Leave out the beef and pile in tofu, mushrooms and yuba in the sweet soy warishita; vegetarians may keep the raw egg dip.
dishes.technique: Ingredients are simmered at the table in a shallow iron pot with a sweet soy-mirin sauce and dipped in beaten raw egg.

dishes.name: Shabu-shabu
dishes.veganApproach: Cook only tofu, mushrooms, vegetables and noodles in the kombu broth and serve with ponzu and a sesame dip.
dishes.technique: Diners swish paper-thin slices and vegetables through a gently simmering kombu broth and dip them in ponzu or sesame sauce.

sources.title: Vegetable Shabu-Shabu in Kombu-Ginger Broth - NYT Cooking

dishes.name: Oden
dishes.veganApproach: Simmer daikon, konnyaku, fried tofu, potatoes and kombu knots in kombu-shiitake dashi and skip the fish cakes; vegetarians can add boiled eggs.
dishes.technique: Ingredients are simmered slowly for hours in a light soy-seasoned dashi until they absorb the broth.

dishes.name: Omurice
dishes.veganApproach: Make the ketchup rice with mushrooms instead of chicken and wrap it in a silken tofu or chickpea-flour omelette; vegetarians keep real eggs.
dishes.technique: Ketchup-fried rice is wrapped in or topped with a thin, soft omelette and finished with more ketchup or demi-glace.

dishes.name: Korokke
dishes.veganApproach: Mash the potatoes with sautéed onion and mushrooms or soy mince, and bread them with a flour-and-water slurry and panko instead of egg.
dishes.technique: Seasoned mashed potato patties are breaded and deep-fried until crisp outside and fluffy within.

dishes.name: Hambagu
dishes.veganApproach: Patties are made from pressed tofu, mushrooms and panko bound with starch, then glazed with a ketchup and Worcestershire sauce.
dishes.technique: Juicy patties are seared, steamed under a lid to cook through and finished with a pan sauce of ketchup and Worcestershire.

sources.title: Vegan Japanese Tofu Hamburger Steak - Veg in Vegan Vegun

dishes.name: Naporitan
dishes.veganApproach: Swap the sausage for mushrooms or plant-based sausage and use vegan butter; vegetarians can finish with parmesan.
dishes.technique: Soft-cooked spaghetti is stir-fried with vegetables and sausage in butter, then coated in reduced ketchup.

dishes.name: Inari-zushi
dishes.nameEn: Sushi rice in sweet fried tofu pouches
dishes.veganApproach: Simmer the tofu pouches in kombu dashi instead of bonito dashi and the dish becomes fully vegan.
dishes.technique: Fried tofu pouches are simmered in sweet soy until saturated, then stuffed with vinegared rice.

dishes.name: Chirashi-zushi
dishes.veganApproach: Scatter the rice with shiitake, kanpyo, lotus root and vegetables simmered in kombu dashi; vegetarians add thin egg-crepe ribbons.
dishes.technique: Vinegared rice is mixed with simmered vegetables and generously scattered with colorful toppings.

dishes.name: Temaki-zushi
dishes.veganApproach: Set out avocado, cucumber, pickles, tofu and marinated mushrooms so everyone rolls plant-based cones.
dishes.technique: Diners roll seasoned rice and fillings in nori into cones at the table, eating them while the seaweed is still crisp.

sources.title: Temaki Sushi (Hand Roll) - Just One Cookbook
Vegan Sushi Rolls - World of Vegan

dishes.name: Nikujaga
dishes.veganApproach: Drop the beef in favor of fried tofu, soy curls or mushrooms and simmer everything in kombu-shiitake dashi.
dishes.technique: Potatoes and meat are simmered under a drop lid in a sweet soy dashi until tender and glazed.

dishes.name: Gindara saikyo-yaki
dishes.technique: Fish is cured with salt, marinated for two to three days in sweet white miso, then broiled or baked until caramelized.

sources.title: Miso Cod (Black Cod with Miso) - Just One Cookbook
Saikyo Miso Sablefish (Black Cod) - Great British Chefs

dishes.name: Shiozake
dishes.technique: Skin-on fillets are salt-cured to firm the flesh and deepen the flavor, then broiled until the skin crisps.

sources.title: Japanese Salted Salmon (Shiozake) - Just One Cookbook

dishes.name: Kare udon
dishes.veganApproach: Use kombu-shiitake dashi, a dairy-free curry roux and fried tofu or mushrooms in place of meat.
dishes.technique: Japanese curry is thinned with dashi into a thick, glossy broth that clings to chewy udon.

sources.title: Japanese Curry Udon - The Foodie Takes Flight

dishes.name: Nabeyaki udon
dishes.veganApproach: Use kombu-shiitake dashi, skip the fish cake, egg and shrimp, and top with vegetable tempura and fried tofu; vegetarians can keep the egg.
dishes.technique: Udon and toppings are simmered in dashi in an individual clay pot, an egg is poached on top and tempura is added at the end.

dishes.name: Hayashi raisu
dishes.nameEn: Hayashi rice (beef and mushroom demi-glace stew)
dishes.veganApproach: Replace the beef with mushrooms and build the demi-glace-style sauce from red wine, tomato and vegetable stock with vegan butter.
dishes.technique: Caramelized onions, mushrooms and beef are simmered in a tomato and demi-glace sauce and served over rice.

dishes.name: Doria
dishes.veganApproach: Make the white sauce with plant milk and vegan butter, use mushrooms in the rice and top with vegan cheese; vegetarians keep the dairy.
dishes.technique: Buttery pilaf is covered in béchamel and cheese and baked until bubbling and browned.

sources.title: Mushroom Doria Rice Casserole - No Recipes

dishes.name: Takikomi gohan
dishes.veganApproach: Cook the rice in kombu-shiitake dashi with mushrooms, root vegetables and fried tofu instead of chicken.
dishes.technique: Raw rice is cooked together with seasoned dashi and chopped ingredients so every grain absorbs their flavor.

sources.title: Japanese Mushroom Rice - Just One Cookbook

dishes.name: Ochazuke
dishes.veganApproach: Top the rice with umeboshi, nori and pickles and pour over green tea or kombu dashi instead of a fish-based broth.
dishes.technique: Hot green tea or dashi is poured over a bowl of rice and savory toppings just before eating.

sources.title: Ochazuke (Green Tea Rice Soup) - Just One Cookbook

dishes.name: Yudofu
dishes.veganApproach: A Kyoto temple dish that is vegan as long as the dipping sauce is made with kombu dashi rather than bonito.
dishes.technique: Soft tofu is warmed gently in a kombu-scented broth at the table and dipped in a light soy sauce.

dishes.name: Yosenabe
dishes.veganApproach: Build a kombu-shiitake broth and load it with tofu, mushrooms, napa cabbage and udon instead of seafood.
dishes.technique: Many ingredients are simmered together in a seasoned dashi in a clay pot at the table.

sources.title: Yosenabe (Japanese Hot Pot) - Just One Cookbook

dishes.name: Kenchin-jiru
dishes.nameEn: Buddhist temple vegetable and tofu soup
dishes.veganApproach: A shojin ryori temple soup that is vegan when made with kombu-shiitake dashi, as tradition intends.
dishes.technique: Root vegetables and crumbled tofu are stir-fried in sesame oil, then simmered in dashi seasoned with soy sauce.

sources.title: Kenchinjiru, Japanese Zen Buddhist Vegetable Soup - Just Hungry

dishes.name: Ganmodoki
dishes.veganApproach: Bind the mashed tofu with grated nagaimo and starch instead of egg.
dishes.technique: Drained tofu is mashed with vegetables and seaweed, shaped into patties and deep-fried, then often simmered in dashi.

dishes.name: Goya champuru
dishes.nameEn: Okinawan bitter melon and tofu stir-fry
dishes.veganApproach: Skip the pork, egg and bonito, using extra tofu and a splash of soy sauce and kombu dashi; vegetarians can keep the egg.
dishes.technique: Salted bitter melon is stir-fried with tofu and pork and bound at the end with beaten egg.

dishes.name: Saba no misoni
dishes.technique: Mackerel is simmered under a drop lid with ginger in sake and water, then miso is dissolved in and the sauce reduced to a glaze.

sources.title: Saba Misoni (Simmered Mackerel in Miso Sauce) - Just One Cookbook
Simmered Mackerel in Miso - RecipeTin Japan

dishes.name: Mentaiko pasuta
dishes.technique: Spicy cod roe is mixed with butter and a splash of soy sauce, then tossed with hot spaghetti off the heat so the roe stays creamy.

sources.title: Classic Mentaiko Pasta - Just One Cookbook
Mentaiko Spaghetti (Japanese Cod Roe Butter) - Serious Eats
